title: Morning, rain
logline: One of the month of mornings, in rain: the flats gray, the tide line a thread, the rain in resist, and the light still inside it, from nowhere, the way the fog morning had it.

panels.composition: The mudflats at dawn in rain, gray on gray, the rain in watercolor resist, the tide line a dark thread, the pup a small shape far out with his back to the weather. The light everywhere and from nowhere.

characters.pose: far out, back to the rain

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, mudflats at dawn in rain rendered with watercolor resist, gray on gray with a dark tide line and a small three-legged dog far out with its back to the weather, light from nowhere, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
